description: ctx lifecycle hooks for Codex (https://ctx.ist). Every command anchors to the git root because ctx is CWD-anchored and Codex runs hooks with the session cwd.

hooks.command: command -v ctx >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)" && ctx agent --budget 8000 2>/dev/null || true
